result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly functional, but there are a few visual issues including a loading spinner on a restaurant card and inconsistent styling of favorite icons.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner overlaid on the image, indicating the image has not finished loading or is stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load properly with appropriate timeout/fallback handling, or display a static placeholder instead of a perpetual spinner.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons have inconsistent styling: one appears on a white/light circular background while the other appears on a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling 'Fastest near you' cards are cut off at the right edge (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol...' text is truncated), which may not clearly indicate scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual scroll affordance or partial card peek to clearly signal that content is horizontally scrollable.
